name: Red Cat Holdings (RCAT)
teaser: Watchlist for new money. The shares trade only 7% below the Base value. Red Cat is not yet profitable, burns cash, depends on one customer for half its revenue and grew its share count 27% in six months, so a 55% margin of safety is required. The buy zone starts at $3.30.
llms: Pre-profit U.S. military drone and unmanned systems maker (Black Widow) with fast revenue growth, $326 million of cash and heavy dilution, valued on forward EV to 2027 revenue after cash burn. Bear $3.86, Base $7.33, Bull $13.86. Verdict HOLD at $6.80 (watchlist for new money), maximum buy price $3.30.
